skill.name: longbridge-portfolio
skill.description: Analyze Longbridge account assets, positions, P&L, statements, risk, rebalancing, orders, and DCA workflows with explicit trading safeguards.
skill.summary: Guides Longbridge portfolio analysis, account review, and guarded order or DCA workflows.
skill.author: longbridge

security_audit.summary: No evidence of Ruby backtick execution or prompt injection was found; the static backtick hits are Markdown code spans, headings, or copied CLI help text. The skill still has high semantic risk because it guides Longbridge brokerage data access and real-money order or DCA operations with explicit confirmation safeguards.

remediation.issue: Real-money order and DCA workflows are included in the same skill as read-only analysis.
remediation.suggestion: Require an install warning for Trade scope and keep the two-step preview and explicit confirmation protocol for every mutation.

remediation.issue: The skill can retrieve sensitive brokerage data such as positions, statements, cash flow, and bank-card records.
remediation.suggestion: Warn before retrieving sensitive account data, avoid unnecessary exports, and keep outputs limited to the user request.

remediation.issue: CLI flags and user-supplied financial parameters can change or be ambiguous.
remediation.suggestion: Validate symbols, dates, quantities, currencies, and plan ids before command use; check help text when command syntax is uncertain.

semantic_findings.title: Real-Money Trading Operations
semantic_findings.description: The skill explicitly supports Longbridge order buy, sell, cancel, replace, and DCA create or update workflows. These operations can move real money, even though the skill requires preview and explicit confirmation.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Multiple files state that order and DCA commands mutate brokerage account state and commit real money. The confirmation protocol lowers misuse risk but does not remove the high impact.

semantic_findings.title: Sensitive Brokerage Account Data Access
semantic_findings.description: The skill retrieves personal financial data including positions, statements, bank cards, cash flow, and account assets. This is legitimate for the skill, but it requires strong user awareness and scope control.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited files describe account-bound holdings, statements, bank cards, and cash-flow retrieval. I found no exfiltration intent, but the data class is sensitive.

content.value_statement: Brokerage data is hard to review across holdings, cash flow, P&L, and orders. This skill guides Longbridge account analysis and guarded order workflows.
actual_capabilities: Reviews Longbridge assets, cash balances, positions, fund holdings, and account statements.
Guides P&L analysis, performance attribution, risk analysis, and rebalancing workflows.
Supports Longbridge order list, detail, buy, sell, cancel, and replace guidance.
Supports DCA plan review, creation, pause, resume, update, and stop guidance.
Provides multilingual response guidance for English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.
limitations: Most account data requires Longbridge authentication and the correct account permission scope.
Trading and DCA actions require explicit user confirmation and may move real money.
The skill does not provide financial, investment, legal, or tax advice.
CLI options and market data availability may change outside the skill.

use_cases.title: Review account health
use_cases.description: Summarize assets, cash, holdings, margin status, and key risks from Longbridge account data.

use_cases.title: Prepare a rebalance plan
use_cases.description: Compare current weights with target allocation and outline trade candidates with risk and tax notes.

use_cases.title: Manage recurring investments
use_cases.description: Review DCA plans and prepare guarded create, pause, resume, update, or stop workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Portfolio Snapshot
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my Longbridge portfolio overview with total assets, cash, holdings, daily P&L, and margin warnings.

prompt_templates.title: Position Risk Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my current Longbridge positions for concentration risk, sector exposure, margin pressure, and major drawdown risks.

prompt_templates.title: Rebalance Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my current portfolio with a target allocation and suggest a rebalance plan with trade size, cost, and tax considerations.

prompt_templates.title: Guarded DCA Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a preview to create a monthly DCA plan for AAPL.US, then wait for my explicit confirmation before any action.

output: A portfolio summary with total assets, cash, holdings, and margin status.
A risk section covering concentration, drawdown, sector exposure, and leverage.
A clear note that the analysis is for reference only.

output_examples.input: Can I buy more TSLA.US with my current account?
output: A buying-power estimate using cash and margin views.
A warning about market, liquidity, and margin risk.
No order is submitted unless the user gives explicit confirmation.

output_examples.input: Review my DCA plans and pause the AAPL plan.
output: A plan list showing matching DCA records and current status.
A pause preview with plan id, symbol, amount, and frequency.
A request for explicit confirmation before any account change.

best_practices: Start with read-only account review before discussing any trade or DCA action.
Verify symbols, amounts, currencies, dates, and plan ids before preparing a mutation preview.
Treat all outputs as reference material and ask a professional for investment or tax advice.
anti_patterns: Do not place, cancel, replace, or schedule orders from ambiguous user messages.
Do not assume missing DCA amount, frequency, currency, start date, or end date values.
Do not export statements or bank-card data unless the user specifically asks for it.

faq.question: Does this skill place trades automatically?
faq.answer: No. It requires a preview and explicit user confirmation before any order or DCA mutation.

faq.question: What Longbridge permissions are needed?
faq.answer: Public commands need no login, account data needs Quote or Trade scope, and mutations need Trade scope.

faq.question: Can it analyze tax-loss harvesting?
faq.answer: Yes, it can outline US tax-loss harvesting opportunities, but it is not tax advice.

faq.question: Can it work without the Longbridge CLI?
faq.answer: The skill can fall back to a Longbridge MCP server when available, but account permissions still apply.

faq.question: Does it support Chinese responses?
faq.answer: Yes. It can respond in English, Simplified Chinese, or Traditional Chinese based on the user message.

faq.question: Is this safe for read-only portfolio review?
faq.answer: Read-only review is lower risk, but it still accesses sensitive brokerage account data.
